text:
incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: inference-gateway error-rate > 7% (5xx spike) across us-west-2 · sustained 3m
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2021769456789 created and notified @oncall-sre · urgency: high
oncall-sre: acked oncall-sre · taking this · switching to #incidents-ops
alice: checking quick metrics — seeing 502/503 from origin pool, RTT spikes on LB
ben: any deploys in last 30m? I don't see anything on the deploy log
camille: Netops flagged increased SYN retries from a subset of origin hosts earlier, could be upstream flapping
derek: running runbook step1 to isolate origin route: `kubectl get svc inference-gateway -o yaml` then `curl -v http://inference-gw.health/ready`
alice: logs show `502 gateway read: upstream reset` from origin-origin-a-3 and origin-a-4
oncall-sre: ok if origins are flaky we can shift traffic to origin-b pool and enable emergency-retries. executing step2 reroute now:
```
# rotate weights away from origin-a
infra-cli route set-weight inference-origin-a=0.1,inference-origin-b=0.9
```
ben: initiated weight change — watching metrics. token TPS steady, error-rate dropping to 4%
camille: PagerDuty escalation will fire at 10m unacked — team, acknowledge if engaged (FYI)
oncall-sre: ack from me, will hold. also bumping replica count for gateway to reduce queue backpressure: `replicas=6 -> 9`
derek: saw a transient surge of retries from clients that retried aggressively, contributing to origin overload — adding short retry-backoff at lb layer
alice: customer impact: approx 0.3% of authenticated requests failed with 5xx in the last 10m, increased for long-seq gen jobs — likely degraded UX but not broad outage
camille: flagged affected customers list to support via #support-ops, adding mitigation notes and ETA ~15m
ben: error-rate now 1.1% and trending down after weight shift and scaling :thumbsup:
oncall-sre: keeping proxied retries off for now, will reenable after origin health stable. monitoring KV cache and latency
derek: adding temporary circuit-breaker for origin-a in envoy config to prevent re-flooding: `max_conn=50, ttl=30s`
alice: confirm origin-a-3 and origin-a-4 show connection errors in `journalctl` — ticketing owner for postmortem
camille: PagerDuty: escalation suppressed (acked). Notifying customers in affected list with initial impact blurb — support to follow up
oncall-sre: switching to 10m watch. if stable at 0.5% or lower we close. please post any follow-ups here
ben: quick smoke: openai-compat route and embeddings routes unaffected, just inference-gateway main path seen earlier
alice: will open incident ticket INC-2021769456789 in tracker with timeline + runbook steps + owners
oncall-sre: resolved? marking as mitigation in progress, will close after 30m stable window
derek: note for postmortem: consider adaptive client throttling and more aggressive origin splay
camille: thanks team — will schedule blameless postmortem and customer comms draft
oncall-sre: closing the slack thread for live ops, will reopen if any regression :white_check_mark:
